description: Fail when a Python file this pull request changed has a Bandit security finding it did not have at the base. Bandit, Python's static security analyser, is pinned in tools/bandit (every wheel digest in the committed requirements file). A ratchet per check: a file is a finding when it has more results of one Bandit check (B602, subprocess with shell=True, say) than at the merge base, or is new and has any; every result of that check in the file is listed. --all reports every result in every tracked Python file, for an audit. Only results at or above --severity and --confidence count (default medium for both). Tests are not read: Bandit flags every assert. The repository's Bandit config files are not read; a line judged safe is marked `# nosec <check id>`. A file Bandit cannot parse is exit 2, never a pass. --source and --exclude change which files count.
